summary: Three auth-specific exception types: TokenExchangeError (code exchange failure), TokenRefreshError (refresh failure), AuthorizationRequired (no valid token and auto_authorize=False).

key_classes.name: TokenExchangeError
key_classes.summary: Raised when OAuth token exchange POST fails. Attributes: url, status_code, body. Body truncated to 200 chars in str.

key_classes.name: TokenRefreshError
key_classes.summary: Raised when OAuth token refresh POST fails. Same attributes as TokenExchangeError.

key_classes.name: AuthorizationRequired
key_classes.summary: Raised when no valid token exists and auto_authorize is False. Attributes: provider, user.

documentation_hooks: When each error is raised in the flow lifecycle

evidence.detail: Three exception classes with keyword-only constructors
All three errors re-exported at package root
Tests for attributes, str formatting, body truncation, raise/catch
